name: jump
description: A jump the player asks for with an action: an upward launch allowed from the ground, with the forgiving touches that make it feel right (a short grace after walking off an edge, a press remembered just before landing, a lower jump for a shorter press) and an optional number of jumps in the air. The ground is what collision2d reports below the body; gravity2d (or any other system) brings it back down.

components.name: Jumper
components.description: The entity jumps when its action (jump when action is none) is pressed: its Velocity y becomes -speed (y grows downwards, so it goes up). It may jump while collision2d.Blocked says there is a floor below it, or up to coyote_time seconds after it left the floor without jumping; a press up to buffer_time seconds before it lands makes it jump on landing. Letting go of the action while still going up multiplies the upward speed by cut (1 always jumps full height, 0.5 halves the speed of a short press). air_jumps is how many more jumps it may make before it touches the ground again. Needs a collision2d.Blocked to know where the ground is. With charge_time more than 0 the jump is charged instead: the action held on the ground fills charge from 0 to 1 in charge_time seconds, and letting it go jumps at speed times a share that goes from charge_low (a tap) to charge_high (a full charge), sideways by up to wobble units a second, more the fuller the charge (a strong leap is less precise; the game's Random says which way); letting go at a full charge also presses full_action (none: nothing) and counts in full_jumps (a leap into the sky, out of a level). A transform2d.Disabled jumper does not hear its action (a character during a cutscene). The other fields are kept by the jump itself: jumps counts the jumps made (an animation, a sound or a rule can watch it), since_ground and since_press are the seconds since the ground was last touched and the action last pressed, air_jumps_used the jumps made in the air since then, and holding is true while a jump is still going up with the action held.

systems.name: launch
systems.description: Starts the jumps that are asked for and allowed, and cuts the upward speed of a jump whose action is let go. Reads where the ground was at the end of the previous tick, and runs before transform2d.integrate so that a jump moves the very tick it starts.
